newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia parliament to vote in May on EU agreement.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia parliament to vote in May on EU agreement.

text.p: The Slovenian parliament said on Wednesday it would vote on whether to ratify an association agreement with the European Union on either May 14 or May 20.
The association agreement, a trade and cooperation pact carrying with it a promise of eventual EU membership, was signed in June last year but has yet to be ratified by most EU parliaments.
Slovenia, which hopes to become a full member of the EU as soon as possible, is the first of the successor states of the former Yugoslavia to have signed the association agreement.
Nine other ex-communist states -- Poland, Hungary, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Estonia, Lithuania, Latvia, Romania and Bulgaria -- have signed similar agreements.
